details.message: We're excited to celebrate Althea Louisse's special milestone with you!
details.covidInfo: We're following local health guidelines. Please stay home if you're feeling unwell.

giftSection.intro:
Your prayers and presence is the greatest gift of all. But if you wish to bless me with something extra, I've prepared a little gift guide to make it easier for you.

- makeup, bags and stylish sandals (37)
- anything that reminds you of me, especially in my favorite color pink
- monetary gift to invest in my future

More than anything, I am just deeply grateful to have you on my special day! Thank you for adding a sparkle on my birthday.
